title: #111 E-books

plans.point1: Physical books offer a unique sensory experience, with the weight and smell of paper enhancing reader engagement and creating a deeper connection to the narrative.
plans.point2: Owning physical books supports cultural heritage and scholarly research because printed copies are preferred for long-term archiving and provide reliable sources for future scholars.
